Quality and Security with a System

Highly Developed Torque Systems for Controlled Fastening

 

We supply selected assembly tools and torque measuring equipment in recognized industrial quality. From repeatable torque wrenches to excellent torque measurement devices, energy-saving cordless impulse screwdrivers, and process-controlled screwdriving systems to individual special tools made to order. Our high-class product line precisely addresses the tools preferred in industrial manufacturing. The renowned brand-name tools have been used successfully for decades in mechanical engineering, in the production of vehicles and conveyors, in the aerospace industry, as well as in plastics processing, electrical appliance manufacturing, and numerous other branches of industry.

 

Strong Brands – Strong Partners

 

  • STURTEVANT RICHMONT (US) 
    Torque wrenches, torque screwdrivers and torque testers from the established US industry leader have been impressing customers for over eight decades (aka 'TORQ-X-PERTS'). Their unrivalled durability, exceptional robustness and lasting accuracy are legendary. Sturtevant Richmont has been certified to ISO-9001 since 2001 and has been accredited to ISO-17025 in the field of torque calibration since 2003. We have been Sturtevant's sole authorised sales and service partner in German-speaking countries (D-A-CH) since 1987. Only at ZEMO can you obtain the world's best torque tools directly from the German importer.

 

  • YOKOTA Industrial (JP)
    High-performance Hi-Tec impulse tools and documenting EC fastening systems from the Japanese specialist have proven themselves in industrial applications worldwide. Yokota is ISO-9001 and ISO-14001 certified. We also offer maintenance, repair and calibration services, as well as suitable power sockets, screwdriver bits and industrial-quality air line and handling accessories.

 

  • CRANE Electronics (UK) 
    Excellent torque measurement technology from the renowned Crane Electronics ensures quality-assured assembly results. Crane is ISO-9001 and ISO-14001 certified and ISO-17025 accredited. Since 1995 we have been Crane's sales partner for high-precision rotating or static torque transducers and data collectors, intelligent torque spanners and, last but not least, bolting simulators.

 

  • TOHNICHI (JP)
    We also stock selected torque products from the renowned Japanese manufacturer Tohnichi, which offers high-quality solutions for very low to very high torques in particular, such as colour-marking torque wrenches, radio-controlled screwdrivers and dial gauges. Focussing on screw tightening control from the outset, Tohnichi developed its first torque spanner in 1951. Tohnichi is also ISO-9001 and ISO-14001 certified.

  • MOUNTZ (US)
    The latest addition to our range of high-quality torque tools comes straight from the birthplace of innovation, California's Silicon Valley. Developed with the legendary precision, accuracy and safety that continue to steer the world of manufacturing in one direction: forwards. Mountz products are built to last and rigorously tested to meet the highest standards. Mountz is an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 17025:2017 certified company. Selected torque screwdrivers and torque spanners now available at ZEMO.

 

Safe and Reliable Pneumatic Pliers 

 

Pneumatically operated cutting, severing, punching, or crimping machines, etc., significantly simplify and accelerate repetitive and/or labor-intensive work processes.
